content:
Technically this happened to me doing next step with tool 7 but posting here as its the first time the nozzles are docked.

The Nozzle Tools have two little magnetic pins that face out towards the front of the printer and engage with the dock. 

One of my nozzles had the pin come out and remain in the dock. About to raise it with support to see if it is safe to glue in. looks like it was a press fit.

My suggestion is that at this step docking the nozzles and then undocking to see if any of the pins are loose and come out of the nozzles. Upto Prusa document mods if they want to add that to this step and what the fix is if it happens. When support gets back to me I will update my comment.

replies.content: Advise from support I got was that it should be OK to use a drop of superglue on the end of the pin. Just make sure it is orientated magnetically the same way as the top pin, otherwise it will repel the dock instead

Seems to have done the trick. 

For reference i used KraftProtz 3D printing superglue gel which is suitable for PLA, ABS, PETG, TPU, etc

content: Ouch, installing the Nozzle tools and one came with the top pin missing!
This is the most satisfying part of the install!
